annotations.title: Send feedback or a bug report to the Neumann team

error_text.description: The error code and message the tool returned, if any. Remove any personal data or user figures it quotes.
error_text.title: Error Text

expected.description: What you expected to happen instead.
expected.title: Expected

feedback_type.description: What kind of report this is. bug: a tool errored or broke. wrong_result: it ran but the numbers look wrong. unmet_use_case: the user needed something no tool does. feature_request: a missing option or parameter. confusing: a description, output or error was hard to understand. praise: something worked well. other: anything else (the default).
feedback_type.title: Feedback Type

impact.description: How much it cost the user. blocked: could not finish. workaround: finished another way. minor: an annoyance. none: no cost, for example praise.
impact.title: Impact

message.description: The report, in your own words, 10 to 5,000 characters. Say what you tried, what happened and what you expected. Leave out names, companies, the user's numbers (inputs or results) and the conversation itself: write "a revenue forecast", not its figures.
examples: rank_inputs_by_impact returned an empty list for a model with two inputs, so I could not tell the user which one mattered more.
message.title: Message

run_id.description: The run_id the report is about, if a run was involved.
run_id.title: Run Id

sender_email.description: Optional. The user's email address, only if they want a reply and gave it to you. Do not invent one. No copy is sent to it.
sender_email.title: Sender Email

suggestion.description: What would have helped: a fix, a new feature or clearer wording.
suggestion.title: Suggestion

tool_name.description: The Neumann tool the report is about, for example run_monte_carlo_simulation.
tool_name.title: Tool Name

user_goal.description: What the user was trying to do, as a general task in a few words, for example "estimate a project budget". No names, company names or figures.
user_goal.title: User Goal

what_happened.description: What actually happened, in general terms, without the user's numbers.
what_happened.title: What Happened

name: send_feedback

AnonymousLimits.description: The limits that apply without an account.

max_nodes.description: Most nodes (inputs plus formula nodes) allowed without an account.
max_nodes.title: Max Nodes

max_trials.description: Most trials allowed in one run without an account.
max_trials.title: Max Trials

AnonymousLimits.title: AnonymousLimits

BillingInfo.description: Who you are and what this call cost. Present on every result. charged_to says what paid; credits_debited and anonymous_runs_remaining_today say how much.

account_id.description: Your account id, or null without an account.
account_id.title: Account Id

account_status.description: matched for an existing account, created when this call created one on first sign-in. Null without an account.
account_status.title: Account Status

anonymous_allowance_resets_at.description: When free runs refill (next UTC midnight), as an ISO-8601 time. Null with an account.
anonymous_allowance_resets_at.title: Anonymous Allowance Resets At

anonymous_limits.description: The no-account limits. Null with an account.

anonymous_runs_remaining_today.description: Free runs left today for a caller without an account, after this call. Null with an account -- see free_runs_remaining_today instead.
anonymous_runs_remaining_today.title: Anonymous Runs Remaining Today

auth_source.description: How you were identified: bearer (a credential sent in the Authorization: Bearer header) or anonymous.
auth_source.title: Auth Source

charged_to.description: What paid for this call: anonymous_allowance (one of the free daily runs for callers without an account), free_daily_run (one of a signed-in account's free daily runs), credits (the account's credit balance), or none (the call is free).
charged_to.title: Charged To

credit_balance.description: Your credit balance after this call. Null without an account.
credit_balance.title: Credit Balance

credits_debited.description: Credits this call used (0 when free).
credits_debited.title: Credits Debited

free_run_limits.description: The size a run must be within to use one of this account's free daily runs. Null unless the account signed in with Kromatic.

free_runs_remaining_today.description: Free runs left today on this account, after this call. Null unless the account signed in with Kromatic: an account created with POST https://neumann.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts has no free daily runs.
free_runs_remaining_today.title: Free Runs Remaining Today

free_runs_reset_at.description: When this account's free daily runs refill (the next UTC midnight), as an ISO-8601 time. Null unless the account signed in with Kromatic.
free_runs_reset_at.title: Free Runs Reset At

principal.description: account when an API key or signed-in connection was recognized, otherwise anonymous.
principal.title: Principal

BillingInfo.title: BillingInfo

SignedInLimits.description: The free signed-in tier's bounds (neumann#334), rendered from ``Settings``.

max_nodes.description: Maximum nodes in a free run's graph.
max_nodes.title: Max Nodes

max_trials.description: Maximum trials in a free run.
max_trials.title: Max Trials

runs_per_day.description: Free runs per UTC calendar day.
runs_per_day.title: Runs Per Day

SignedInLimits.title: SignedInLimits

billing.description: Who you are and what this call cost: principal, auth source, credits debited and balance, or the anonymous allowance left today.

message.description: Confirmation text, including whether the team can reply.
message.title: Message
